metric_definitions.hit@k: Share of answerable (single + multi) questions where at least one of the top k chunks comes from an expected document AND covers its expected location (article/section/recital, or PDF page). Unanswerable questions are excluded from the denominator.
metric_definitions.multi_all_evidence@k: Share of multi questions where every expected passage is covered by some top-k chunk.
metric_definitions.avg_words@k: Average words in the top k chunks over all questions: what retrieval adds to the prompt.
metric_definitions.mean_top1_score: Mean cosine similarity of the best chunk, for answerable vs unanswerable questions; shows whether a score threshold could separate them.
